name: Tongueless
source:
Ren's here again, staring. Two years living together. Friends since high school. She sorts your sketches, straightens your bed… but something feels off.

[From [url=https://mangolobster19.itch.io/tongueless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷恩又来了，盯着看。同居两年了。从高中开始的朋友。她整理你的草图，整理你的床……但感觉有些不对劲。

[来自[url=https://mangolobster19.itch.io/tongueless]Itch.io[/url]]
